verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a broad REST API surface (workspace-level APIs, Unity Catalog objects manageable via CLI/SQL/REST, Jobs REST API, SDKs for Python, and Databricks Connect for embedding), so many core data engineering and governance actions available in the UI can also be scripted via API/CLI/SDK. However, the evidence doesn't show explicit API parity for interactive/AI-native UI surfaces like Genie natural-language chat, AI/BI dashboard authoring, or the Assistant panel, and no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe returned 404s), while API versions are also fragmenting (legacy vs v2.0 endpoints) which complicates full UI-API equivalence claims. missing for 10: documented API/CLI equivalents for Genie conversational analytics and AI/BI dashboard creation, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and explicit statement of full UI-API parity.
